chat_history.content: 👋 Hi! I'm your FOREO assistant. Ask me about warranty, cleaning, charging, orders, or account help.
how can I track the status of my order ?

1) Your account will show that your order is “completed” once your order is confirmed; 2) verified; 3) When the order is shipped, you will be emailed a tracking number that you can use to track your package on the website of the shipping company
To help you better, Which country are you located in?

FOREO uses DHL/UPS for most deliveries Please note that although we do ship worldwide, some orders are subject to additional customs inspections or duties upon delivery. Regrettably, we cannot deliver to P.O. boxes.
can we connect to customer support?
I understand you'd like to speak with our support team. To create a support ticket, I'll need a few details. What's your name?
To create a support ticket, What's your email address?
